## Recruitment RESOURCES

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/adventure-on-torn-
edge-element-1024-x-54@3x-1024x48.png)

Nothing highlights the fun and excitement of Scouting like being in the
outdoors. Whether it’s daycamp, summer camp, or a fall camporee, getting
outside is what kids want to do! And no one does ”the outdoors” better than
the BSA. Let’s help new families join the fun. With these recruiting
materials, invite families to join us in the outdoors as we #AdventureOn!

## #AdventureOn Materials

Fliers, posters, logos and more! Check out the BSA Brand Center for the latest
in customizable recruiting materials. Download, print and go!

[ BSA Brand Center ](https://scouting.webdamdb.com/bp/#/)

## Social Media Calendar

One of the best ways to reach families today is through social media. For many
of us, the hard part is determining what and when to post. Here’s a calendar
of social media posts to help you get started.

[ Cub Scouts Social Calendar ](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/03/Cub-Scouts-Social-Calendar-CSBC.xlsx)

[ Scouts BSA Social Calendar ](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/03/Scouts-BSA-Social-Calendar-SBBC.xlsx)

## Campaign Kits are your Blueprints for Marketing Success

These campaign kits provide step-by-step tips to host a successful joining
event, promote your Pinewood Derby, Scouting for Food, or market just about
anything you like. From planning to promotion to follow up, these kits include
a set of integrated marketing elements designed to work together to help you
build a solid foundation for success.

Are their other things you could do? Yes! But we strongly recommend you start
with these key elements and work your way forward.  Along with campaign
elements, you’ll also find links to helpful how-to’s and marketing resources.  

And more campaign kits are on the way!

Ready to build a great campaign?  Fantastic!  So, grab your tools and let’s
get to work!
